files.description: Mission config used by the Node headless runtime.
Forecast, belief, uncertainty, priority, flow, hazard, mask, and staleness fields.
Noisy observations sampled along the provided waypoint route.
Compact P9 public-safe forecast-correction and hidden-event hypothesis diagnostics.
Lightweight replay path and observation references.

notes: Node headless runtime over portable ANCHOR core logic. Browser ANCHOR remains the official visual referee and scoring UI.
Hidden truth export disabled; hidden_fields.json omitted.
bundle.json is a convenience single-file import for the H2 browser bundle viewer.
P9 science diagnostics are public-safe educational heuristics and do not embed hidden truth fields.
H1/H2/H3/P9 do not implement Python OceanBox, a new planner, MARL/RL, production data assimilation, or calibrated ocean forecasting.
